column1: TABLE RoommateStatus-main-migrations - in-place data-migration ledger, written by infrastructure/migrations/runner.py (NOT the Flask app). This table is the source of truth for whether a migration has run in this environment; the per-migration status.md is human documentation only. Two item shapes share it: one ledger row per applied/reverted/failed migration (id = the migration folder name), plus a single transient lock row (id = lock#<env>) held while the runner is applying migrations so two runs can't overlap.
